Services / Debugging & ongoing support

Understand the fault.
Plan the next fix.

I investigate existing software and hardware/software issues through logs, device signals and application behaviour. Maintenance and ongoing support are scoped around the system you have.

What I can investigate

Follow the evidence across the system.

Software faults

Reproduce issues in interfaces, APIs and background jobs. Review relevant logs and isolate likely causes.

Device-connected issues

Investigate device events, communication and software behaviour. Hardware access and diagnostic boundaries are agreed first.

Maintenance

Dependency updates, scoped fixes, technical documentation and monitoring work for an existing product.

Clear expectations

From symptoms to a clear next step.

  • Review the symptoms

    Share the expected behaviour, what actually happens, when it started and what has already been tried.

  • Agree on safe access

    Define access to code, logs, test environments and any physical devices before investigation.

  • Separate findings from fixes

    Document evidence, likely causes and open questions. Agree on implementation or further investigation separately.

  • Define ongoing support

    Agree on included tasks, availability and response expectations. No 24/7 coverage or emergency response is implied.
